about: How Studio groups the engine's menu (npm run menu) into tabs. This file only regroups: every entry must name a menu section or an item id the engine already has, and npm run check fails on an unknown one. An item can sit in more than one tab. A tab with no items is hidden in Studio and listed in docs/studio.md as a candidate to build next. Studio shows the tabs as 9 layers (layers, each a list of tab groups): every option lives in exactly one layer. layerOrder says which layer claims an option first when tabs share it, owners moves one to a named layer, hidden drops a duplicate name. npm run check fails when an option lands in no layer.

layers.label: Text
layers.hint: Captions (the running words), kinetic words and big titles. Fonts live in Fonts, stickers in Graphics.

layers.label: Fonts
layers.hint: The type pairs for titles and captions.

layers.label: Graphics
layers.hint: Not text: lower thirds and name tags, stickers and callouts, data cards, logos, CTAs.

layers.label: Color and finish
layers.hint: Grades, themes, grain, vignette, scan lines and glitches.

layers.label: Motion
layers.hint: Camera moves, zoom punch, you and the room, speed and time.

layers.label: Music and sounds
layers.hint: Music beds, energy, sound effects and pace. Ducking under your voice is always on.

layers.label: B-roll
layers.hint: How b-roll sits: splits, match cuts, phone fans, carousels, screen cards.

layers.label: Layout
layers.hint: Frames, split screens and grids around you.

categories.label: Kinetic text and title entrances
categories.hint: How big titles arrive, where they sit, and the type they use.

categories.label: Captions
categories.hint: The running words: their style and how each word enters.

categories.label: Motion graphics
categories.hint: Every animated graphic the overlay draws (the engine's Graphics section).

categories.label: Stickers, emoji and callouts
categories.hint: Small things that point, pop or stamp.

categories.label: Camera effects
categories.hint: Punch-ins, pushes and moves (effects the catalog marks as camera, plus the zoom punch on cuts).

categories.label: Person and background
categories.hint: Titles behind your head, the room changing around you, you cut out.

categories.label: Color grades
categories.hint: Grades, themes and the overall look.

categories.label: Shapes, frames and split screens
categories.hint: Cards, frames, splits and grids around you.

categories.label: B-roll and media
categories.hint: Your screenshots, reels and pages on screen.

categories.label: Audio
categories.hint: Music beds, sounds, the sound cap and beat sync. Ducking under your voice is always on.

categories.label: Intros, outros and CTAs
categories.hint: The hook, chapters and the ask at the end.

candidates.label: Speed ramps and slow motion
candidates.note: The engine cuts and freezes but does not change playback speed.

candidates.label: Emoji
candidates.note: Stickers cover hearts, stars and fire; there is no emoji picker.

candidates.label: Intro stings and logo reveals
candidates.note: Only the end card and number pop exist.

candidates.label: Light and lens effects
candidates.note: Light leak is a transition; there is no lens flare or bokeh overlay.

candidates.label: Sound design: ducking controls
candidates.note: Ducking is automatic; there is no per-clip control.
